chunks: And my father (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to me from Sa'd ibn Abdillah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Barqi, from Abd al-'Azeem, from Al-Hasan, from Abu Salamah, who said:
Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon him) said: The heavens and the earth did not weep except over Yahya ibn Zakariyya and Al-Husayn (peace be upon him).
ai.seo_question: Who did the heavens and earth weep for according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) highlights the cosmic grief of the heavens and earth over the martyrdom of Yahya ibn Zakariyya and Al-Husayn ibn Ali, establishing a profound theological link between the Prophetic and Imami lineages. This narration, found in Ibn Qulawayh’s *Kamil al-Ziyarat*, underscores the unique spiritual station of Al-Husayn, whose suffering resonates with the natural world, a concept central to Shia devotional practices and the theology of the Ahl al-Bayt.
